notes:
— Primary goal: reduce AHT and TTF (time-to-first-response) for Level 1 agents via summarization + suggested macros.
— Current stack: Zendesk (main), Freshdesk for a subset of SMB customers. Need bi-directional macros and tag sync.
— Data sample: 120k tickets/mo, periodic spikes to ~220 req/s during campaigns. Want system to be resilient to spikes without large cost increase.
— Model preference: high-precision summarization (short 1–2 sentence TL;DR) and deterministic tagging taxonomy. Customer asked about fallback to quantized model during bursts.
— Security: enterprise SSO (SAML), audit trails for every generated macro, optional KMS for key management; some EU customers require residency.
— "We can’t surface suggestions that change ticket severity without audit history" — Head of Ops (quote).
— POC scope suggested: 7 days, anonymized Zendesk export for 50k tickets, live agent assist on 2 support teams, measure precision/recall of tags, latency percentiles, and cost per 1k summaries.
— Integration notes: prefer Zendesk App + webhook for macro application; fallback pathway via canned responses if Redwood endpoint slow.
— Open question: acceptable mismatch rate for auto-tags before requiring human-in-loop (customer suggests 90% precision).
— Drive: pricing deck + security FAQ in linked drive folder.
— Jira: CSUP-4521 opened to track token scoping for Zendesk export.
summary_requirements: Short abstractive summaries (1–2 sentences) for ticket and email threads; preserve sentiment and key action items; include 3 suggested macros ranked; support streaming to agent UI.
latency_targets: Median < 300ms for UI summary; p95 < 700ms under normal load; graceful degradation to 200–300ms with quantized fallback during spikes.
throughput_targets: Sustain 250 req/s burst for up to 30 minutes; baseline 80 req/s; expected 120k summarized items/month.
integration_points: Zendesk (app + webhook + macro API), Freshdesk (webhook), internal CRM sync via REST, SAML SSO, KMS integration for private deployment.
pricing_constraints: Tight per-ticket cost target; preference for committed Dedicated pricing if Redwood can guarantee latency and predictable unit economics during spikes.
poC_details: 7-day Dedicated POC; dataset: anonymized 50k tickets; success criteria = 90% auto-tag precision OR >40% agent adoption of suggested macros; measure cost delta vs current human triage.
sales_notes: Champion: Head of Support (Maya R.). Tech champion: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Ravi K.). Procurement timeline aggressive — wants vendor selection by 2026-04. Be prepared to show rollout plan for EU residency and audit logging.
last_meeting_snippet: Maya: 'If we can reliably surface the top-3 macros and reduce triage time by 30% we're in.' — follow-up: send POC logistics and anonymized export instructions.
visible_risks: Regulatory residency for EU clients; Zendesk API rate limits on historical exports; pricing for sustained burst capacity.
recommended_redwood_playbook:
Start with Hosted API demo for quick wins (summaries) -> move to Dedicated for POC to guarantee throughput -> Private for EU-residency customers; enable quantized fallback and prefix caching to lower token costs.
Provide pre-built Zendesk App template, sample macros, and a one-week observability dashboard showing latency, token cost, and tag precision.
